snapshot.rule: Core set only: 481 tasks / 951 tests (416 privileged, 481 standard, 54 realtime). A task is in the core set when tasks.json set is "core". Modes on the board for that task are the letters in its core flag (p, s, t). Overall: a core task counts as solved only if every core mode it has was solved. Standard / Privileged / Realtime: every core test of that mode. Success is the official S mark (verifier reward >= 1 within the token budget). One counted attempt per agent and test. Ranked agents are exam.json leaderboard.shared.runs (11). GPT-6 Luna (codex-gpt6_luna-xhigh) is present in exam.json runs but listed in leaderboard.shared.core_off and is not on the official board; do not rank it.
